name: Agave Birrieria
notes: Photo 1 is a poster listing item names with no prices (Tacos, Quesadillas, Burritos, A La Carta, Breakfast Burritos); photos 2 and 3 are TV menu boards with full sections and prices, and most items overlap. Merged all three: items priced on photos 2/3 use those prices; items that appear only on photo 1's poster (Suadero taco/burrito, Mulitas, Birria Fries, Carne Asada Fries, and the breakfast burritos) are included with price omitted since no legible price exists. Beverages, aguas frescas, and the generic side-order price list (beans, rice, cheese, sour cream, guacamole, salsa by the oz) were skipped as drinks/modifiers, not dishes.
